blocks.text: Xylem podon ka woh vascular tissue (pani aur ghiza le jane wala tissue) hai jo pani aur us mein ghule minerals ko jaron se tane aur patton tak le jata hai. Yeh pode ki banawat ka aham hissa bhi hai aur pode ke jism ko mechanical sahara deta hai.

blocks.alt: Xylem ke chaar qism ke cells saath saath. Fibre: lamba dukla-numa (spindle) cell, moti deewar aur darar jaise pits. Tracheid: lambi patli gehri nali, nokeele ek doosre par charhe sire aur pits. Vessel: chauri khuli nali jis ki deewaron mein pits. Xylem parenchyma: teen zinda cells ka sutoon, har ek mein cytoplasm aur nucleus, aakhri deewaron mein pits. Labels: Fibre, Tracheid, Vessel, Xylem Parenchyma, Cytoplasm, Nucleus, Pit.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.8: Xylem tissue ke mukhtalif hisse (kitab ki Figure 8.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Xylem mein tracheids, vessels, xylem fibres aur xylem parenchyma hote hain (kitab yahan Fig. 8.7 likhti hai; xylem ke hisse Figure 8.8 mein hain).

Tracheids lambe aur patle cells hain jin ki deewarein lignin ki wajah se moti hoti hain. In ke sire nokeele (tapered) hote hain aur yeh bordered pits ke zariye aapas mein jure hote hain; in pits se pani ek cell se saath wale cell mein pehlu ki taraf (lateral) ja sakta hai. Vessels tracheids ke muqable mein chhote aur chaure hote hain. Yeh ek seedhi qatar mein lage hote hain aur musalsal naliyan bana dete hain. In ke siron par perforation plates (surakh wali deewarein) hoti hain jin se pani asani se guzarta hai. Xylem fibres lambe cells hain jin ki deewarein lignin se moti hoti hain. Pak jane par yeh murda ho jate hain aur xylem ko mazbooti dete hain; yeh pode ko izafi sahara bhi dete hain. Xylem parenchyma zinda cells hain jin ki deewarein patli hoti hain aur jo nutrients aur pani ko rok kar rakh sakte hain. Xylem parenchyma pani aur nutrients ko pehlu ki taraf le jane mein hissa lete hain aur xylem tissue ke zakhm bharne aur dobara banne mein bhi madad kar sakte hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Tracheids aur vessels murda, khali naliyan hain jin se pani oopar jata hai; pits se pani ek nali se doosri mein chala jata hai. Fibres sirf mazbooti dete hain. Xylem parenchyma hi zinda hissa hai, is liye sirf us mein nucleus aur cytoplasm dikhaye gaye hain; yeh khoorak aur pani zakheera karta hai.
